annotations.title: Insider trades: who is buying and selling their own shares

description: Live insider trades read straight from the regulators (v5.732): SEC Form 4 sales, buys and option exercises plus Form 144 planned sales for the United States, BaFin (Germany), AMF (France), Finansinspektionen (Sweden) and AFM (Netherlands) directors' dealings for Europe, EDINET large holder reports for Japan when enabled. Without a ticker it returns the market summary (insider sales and buys in dollars, the sell to buy ratio, the biggest sales, buys and planned sales, the most sold and most bought names). With a ticker, company or insider name it returns that name's filings. Canada, Australia, Hong Kong and India answer with their official source, they need a data licence first.

ticker.description: Optional ticker, ISIN, company or insider name, e.g. NVDA
